name: @pedospe/payment-qr
description: Reads what a payments app scans or pastes (Stellar addresses, SEP-7 payment URIs, app payment links, charge links, EMVCo merchant QR codes such as PIX and Argentina's interoperable QR) and builds payment links

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src test --max-warnings=0 && prettier --check src test
